Senate Republicans have been confirming President Trump's nominees at a historic pace.
 
Despite Democrats' political games, 95% of civilian nominees have been confirmed - the fastest and highest rate in 25 years.
 
We’ll continue to deliver results for the American people and move our country forward!

Lindsey understood that peace is secured through strength.

The Senate just passed the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act, honoring his legacy and advancing his and President Trump’s goal to end Moscow’s war.

I’m pleased it also includes a version of my bipartisan Solidify Iran Sanctions Act to extend key sanctions on Iran.

posts.text: On Purple Heart Day, we honor the brave Americans who were wounded or gave their lives in the line of duty. Because of their extraordinary courage and sacrifice, we continue to enjoy the blessings of freedom. We will never forget all they have given in service to our nation.

As a new school year begins across South Carolina, we’re reminded that every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and succeed.

The Working Families Tax Cuts created the first of its kind Education Freedom Tax Credit to provide flexible scholarships for K-12 students in low- and middle-income communities.

I'll continue to fight to make quality education more accessible for every family! #BackToSchoolMonth

posts.text: As president of the Dove Fund in Charleston, Amy Forney connects those in need with housing and brings hope to families across South Carolina. Her compassion and determination were recently on full display when she helped a man experiencing homelessness secure low-income housing after taking the time to build trust and connect him with the resources he needed. Amy is changing lives across the Lowcountry! #SCSweetTea

I am heartbroken by the loss of Master Deputy Jillian Olson of the Lexington County Sheriff's Department.

Jillian dedicated her life to serving and protecting others, and her selflessness and commitment to her community will be remembered.

Please join me in praying for her family, friends, and the entire Lexington County Sheriff's Department during this difficult time.
posts.summary: Honors fallen law enforcement officer, calls for prayer and remembrance
